releases.title: Oh My GUI public preview
changes: Oh My GUI branding across the desktop app, installer, setup, and tray.
Project chats, agent activity, and file editing in a shared desktop workspace.
Installer detects an existing Oh My Pi runtime and can install or update it during setup.

releases.title: Desktop preview
changes: Shared web and desktop workspace with the floating file editor and Markdown source/visual modes.
Custom Windows installer, first-launch setup, tray navigation and quit confirmation.
Installer stages, package integrity checks and installed-runtime verification.
Version information, release notes and signed-update controls. Live delivery requires a configured release channel.
